WAS IST HALALCHECK?
HalalCheck ist eine Suchmaschine für Lebensmittel, die sowohl im Web als auch über mobile Applikation in kompakter Form unterwegs nutzbar ist. Das Projekt wurde von freiwilligen muslimischen Geschwistern speziell für Menschen angefertigt, die nähere Informationen zu den versteckten tierischen und alkoholischen Hilfs- und Inhaltsstoffen der Lebensmittel benötigen.

MEHR TRANSPARENZ FÜR ALLE
Ganz nach dem Motto "Transparenz schafft Wissen und Wissen bestärkt den Glauben" richtet sich HalalCheck nicht nur an muslimische Verbraucher, sondern auch an Vegetarier, Alkoholiker und Andersgläubige. Das Ziel dieses Projektes ist es, für alle Interessierten Verbraucher mehr Transparenz und Erleichterung sowohl beim Einkaufen, als auch im Alltag, zu etablieren. UNSERE QUELLEN
Die Hersteller der Produkte werden persönlich von dem HalalCheck-Team sowohl schriftlich, oder auch telefonisch kontaktiert. Alle Informationen basieren somit auf den Herstelleraussagen, die von unserem Produktanalyse-Team im Anschluss analysiert und ins System eingetragen werden.

* Import recipes from website
Search for recipes on the web and add them straight to your recipe collection. Copy and paste the link of the website into ReciMe and the recipe imports in seconds. Hundreds of websites supported. Customise imported recipes to suit your needs. 
    
* Find recipes instantly
Lookup recipes by name or ingredient. Explore recipes by categories (quick, easy, healthy, budget friendly), by meal type (breakfast, dinner, dessert), by appliance (instant pot, air fryer), by cuisine (mediterranean, asian) and more! Thousands of recipes to try, no matter your skill level. 
    
* Filter recipes by what’s in your pantry
Don't know what to cook with what's in your pantry or fridge? Filter for recipes by a single ingredient, or multiple ingredients. Not only will you save yourself another trip to the supermarket…but you’ll also be reducing your food waste too!
    
* Automate your grocery lists
One automated grocery list for all of your meals. Meal plan by adding recipes to your grocery list. Shop by supermarket aisle or by recipe. No more trips back to the store for that one thing you forgot. Timesaver!
    
* Create unlimited cookbooks 
Customize your recipes into cookbooks. Organize recipes by meal type (breakfast, lunch, dinner), cuisine, ingredient and more!
    
* Step-by-step cooking mode
Follow recipes step-by-step so you can focus in the kitchen. Switch this mode on by tapping ‘Start Cooking Now’ on any recipe card.
    
* Choose who can see your recipes
Share your recipes with the world, or keep them as family secrets - it’s entirely up to you! Publish recipes to the community, or keep them private. 
    
* Access across all devices
Create one account and access recipes on your iPhone, iPad and any other device. No additional charges.
    
* Share your cooking with friends and family
Time to get social! Once you upload your recipes, your friends will be able to see them if they follow you on ReciMe. Or, send the recipe directly through SMS, Whatsapp, Messenger or any other way you like to communicated.
    
* Adjust recipe serving size
Unexpected guests? Adjust serving size up or down and let ReciMe automatically recalculate your ingredients for you.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

ReciMe is free to download and use all features. 

We have a premium subscription to:

1. Import unlimited recipes from any website or blog, and 
2. Upload unlimited private recipes to your private recipe collection. 
You can start a 7-day free trial to access these premium features. 

Unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the free trial, you will be automatically charged a price indicated on the payment screen for a chosen subscription period. 

The ReciMe Premium subscription renews automatically at the end of each period (each month or year) until you cancel. Canceling your subscription means the automatic renewal will be disabled. However, you will still have access to all your subscription features for the remaining time of your then-current period.

Note that deleting the app does not cancel your subscriptions.
